products.name: Medical Visualization Devices (Endoscopes and Endocouplers)
products.description: Designs and manufactures advanced optical medical devices, including traditional and digital endoscopes, endocouplers, and custom imaging and illumination products for minimally invasive surgical and diagnostic procedures. Products are manufactured using proprietary optical and imaging technology, including CMOS sensor integration, and are available in both reusable and single-use formats.

products.name: Microprecision™ Lenses and Micro Medical Cameras
products.description: Develops and manufactures ultra-small, high-precision optical lenses and micro medical cameras, leveraging proprietary Microprecision™ optics technology and advanced manufacturing techniques. These products enable the creation of millimeter-sized cameras and endoscopes with high image quality and are used in both medical and defense/aerospace applications.

products.name: Unity Imaging Platform
products.description: Provides a modular, customizable CMOS-based endoscopic imaging system platform for medical device companies, offering a standard baseline system with options for customization and rapid prototyping to production. The platform is designed for both reusable and single-use endoscopic systems and accelerates development and integration for customers.

products.name: Custom Optical Components and Assemblies (Ross Optical)
products.description: Supplies custom and catalog optical components and assemblies, including lenses, prisms, mirrors, windows, and complex mechano-optical assemblies, for medical, defense, and industrial applications. Products are sourced globally and may include in-house thin film optical coatings and assembly services.

products.name: Engineering and Product Development Services
products.description: Provides engineering and product development services, including assessment of customer needs, device design, and creation of manufacturing processes for optical assemblies and medical devices. Services are offered under contract and support both the design and transition to manufacturing for customer products.

products.name: Systems Manufacturing Services
products.description: Offers contract manufacturing and assembly services for complex optical components and systems, serving both medical device and defense/aerospace customers. Services include handling high-complexity components, micro-optical assemblies, and advanced manufacturing challenges, leveraging specialized manufacturing infrastructure.

products.name: Micro-Optics Laboratory Products and Services
products.description: Develops and manufactures micro-optical components and assemblies, supporting both internal product lines and external customers in medical, defense, and industrial markets. The laboratory specializes in advanced micro-optics fabrication and assembly.

products.name: Gene Therapy for Huntington’s Disease (AMT-130)
products.description: A one-time administered gene therapy using an AAV-based vector and proprietary gene-silencing technology (miQURE platform) to target and silence the huntingtin gene in the brain, delivered via stereotactic neurosurgical procedure. Requires advanced manufacturing of viral vectors and regulated clinical administration.

products.name: Gene Therapy for Temporal Lobe Epilepsy (AMT-260)
products.description: A gene therapy using an AAV9 vector to deliver engineered miRNAs targeting the GRIK2 gene in the brain for patients with refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy. Delivered locally via neurosurgical procedure, requiring specialized manufacturing and clinical expertise.

products.name: Gene Therapy for Fabry Disease (AMT-191)
products.description: An investigational gene therapy using an AAV5 vector with a liver-specific promoter to deliver the GLA gene, enabling patients to produce α-galactosidase A enzyme. Administered intravenously, requiring advanced vector manufacturing and regulated clinical delivery.

products.name: Gene Therapy for SOD1-ALS (AMT-162)
products.description: A one-time, intrathecally administered gene therapy using a recombinant AAVrh10 vector expressing a miRNA to silence the SOD1 gene in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis caused by SOD1 mutations. Requires specialized vector manufacturing and clinical neurology expertise.

products.name: Hemophilia B Gene Therapy (HEMGENIX® / etranacogene dezaparvovec)
products.description: A gene therapy for hemophilia B enabling patients to produce their own factor IX protein, reducing bleeding risk. Commercial rights are licensed to CSL Behring, with manufacturing and supply provided via contract manufacturing organizations. Requires large-scale vector production and regulated distribution.

products.name: Forged Hardened Steel Rolls
products.description: Manufactured through forging processes, these high-performance steel rolls are used primarily in hot and cold rolling mills by producers of steel, aluminum, and other metals. Production requires specialized metallurgical engineering and heavy industrial manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Cast Rolls
products.description: Produced in a variety of iron and steel qualities, these rolls are cast and used mainly in hot strip mills, medium/heavy section mills, roughing mills, and plate mills. Manufacturing involves casting processes and metallurgical expertise.

products.name: Forged Engineered Products (FEP)
products.description: Custom-forged metal components sold to the steel distribution market, oil and gas industry, and aluminum and plastic extrusion industries. Production involves advanced forging and engineering tailored to customer specifications.

products.name: Custom-Engineered Finned Tube Heat Exchange Coils and Heat Transfer Products
products.description: Custom-designed finned tube heat exchange coils and related heat transfer products for OEMs and commercial, nuclear power generation, and industrial manufacturing. Production is engineering-intensive and requires specialized manufacturing.

products.name: Custom-Designed Air Handling Systems
products.description: Large, custom-designed air handling systems for institutional, pharmaceutical, and general industrial building markets. These systems are engineered and manufactured to customer specifications and require significant fabrication and assembly.

products.name: Centrifugal Pumps
products.description: Manufactures centrifugal pumps for fossil-fueled power generation, marine defense, and industrial refrigeration industries. Production involves precision engineering and assembly of pump systems for demanding industrial applications.

products.name: Specialty Health Care Services
products.description: Provision of specialized health care personnel to client projects, delivered through long-term and short-term billable employees. Requires in-person human labor and regulated professional expertise.

products.name: Engineering and Technical Services
products.description: Assignment of engineering and technical personnel to client projects, utilizing both salaried and hourly billable employees. Delivered through in-person professional labor for various technical assignments.

products.name: Life Sciences, Data and Solutions Services
products.description: Deployment of life sciences and data solutions personnel to client assignments, involving specialized expertise in scientific and data-driven projects. Delivered through professional staffing for client needs.

products.name: Equity Investment Management
products.description: Actively and passively managed equity investment strategies across global and regional markets, delivered through mutual funds, separately managed accounts, and other vehicles. Requires in-depth research, portfolio management, and regulated investment infrastructure.

products.name: Fixed Income Investment Management
products.description: Actively and passively managed fixed income strategies, including taxable and tax-exempt bonds, delivered via mutual funds, separate accounts, and other vehicles. Involves research, portfolio management, and compliance with financial regulations.

products.name: Multi-Asset and Alternative Investment Solutions
products.description: Outcome-oriented and asset-allocation strategies, including target-date, target-risk, income, total-return portfolios, hedge funds, private alternatives, and customized solutions. Delivered through funds and separate accounts, requiring portfolio construction and risk management expertise.

products.name: Private Wealth Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive investment and wealth management services for high-net-worth individuals and families, including portfolio management, tax and estate planning, and philanthropic advice. Delivered through tailored accounts and advisory relationships, requiring regulated advisory infrastructure and specialized expertise.

products.name: Retail Investment Products and Services
products.description: Investment management and related services for individual investors, primarily through mutual funds, sub-advisory relationships, and separately managed account programs. Distributed via financial intermediaries and requires fund administration and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Institutional Investment Management Services
products.description: Investment management services for institutional clients such as pension plans, foundations, endowments, and insurance companies, delivered through separately managed accounts, sub-advisory relationships, and collective investment trusts. Requires customized portfolio management and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Systematic and Quantitative Investment Strategies
products.description: Alpha-seeking and risk-controlled investment strategies using quantitative research, data-driven signals, and disciplined portfolio construction, delivered through funds and separate accounts. Requires advanced analytics and technology infrastructure.

products.name: Bernstein Research Services (historical)
products.description: Investment research and brokerage execution services for institutional clients, delivered through research reports and trade execution. Relied on research analysts and trading infrastructure; now deconsolidated and operated via joint venture.

products.name: Belapectin (Galectin-3 Inhibitor) for Liver Fibrosis and Cirrhosis in MASH
products.description: A proprietary, plant-derived complex carbohydrate drug formulated for intravenous administration, developed to treat advanced liver fibrosis and cirrhosis in patients with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), with a focus on preventing esophageal varices and reducing portal hypertension. Manufactured via chemical processing of plant materials and delivered through clinical infusion.

products.name: Belapectin (Galectin-3 Inhibitor) for Cancer Immunotherapy
products.description: A proprietary, plant-derived complex carbohydrate drug developed for use in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors to enhance immune response in cancer patients, specifically targeting advanced or metastatic melanoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Delivered via intravenous infusion in clinical settings.

products.name: Small Molecule Galectin-3 Inhibitors (Oral)
products.description: A pipeline of orally administered small molecule inhibitors of galectin-3, developed through a joint venture, intended to expand the therapeutic uses of galectin-3 inhibition for fibrotic diseases and cancer. These are in preclinical development and are designed for oral delivery, potentially offering alternative administration routes to intravenous belapectin.

products.name: EV Charging Equipment (Level 2 and DC Fast Chargers)
products.description: Manufacture and sale of Level 2 (AC) and DC Fast Charging (DCFC) electric vehicle charging stations for commercial, residential, and international markets. Hardware is produced via contract manufacturing and delivered to customers or installed at various locations.

products.name: Networked EV Charging Services (Blink Network)
products.description: Provision of cloud-based software services for remote monitoring, management, pricing, payment processing, and data reporting for EV charging stations. Delivered digitally via the proprietary Blink Network platform to commercial property partners and EV drivers.

products.name: Public EV Charging Services (Owner-Operator and Hybrid Models)
products.description: Operation of Blink-owned or hybrid-owned EV charging stations at public and commercial locations, providing charging services directly to EV drivers for a fee. Blink installs, owns, and maintains the stations, retaining a share of charging revenues.

products.name: Host-Owned EV Charging Solutions
products.description: Sale of EV charging equipment and provision of network connectivity, payment processing, and optional maintenance services to property partners who own and operate the charging stations themselves.

products.name: EV Charging Mobile Applications
products.description: Development and provision of mobile apps (iOS and Android) for EV drivers to locate, access, and pay for charging sessions at Blink stations. Delivered as digital software.

products.name: Energy Management Systems for Fleets
products.description: Provision of software-driven energy management systems (EMS) to fleet operators, enabling optimization of energy costs and integration with fleet management solutions. Delivered as a digital service integrated with charging hardware.

products.name: EV Car-Sharing Services
products.description: Operation of electric vehicle car-sharing programs through a wholly owned subsidiary, offering subscription and on-demand access to EVs for customers. Requires physical fleet management and digital reservation systems.

products.name: Maintenance and Extended Warranty Services for EV Chargers
products.description: Provision of maintenance and extended warranty programs for Blink charging equipment, offered as add-on services to hardware customers and property partners.

products.name: Mobile Health Services
products.description: A suite of technology-enabled healthcare services delivered directly to patients at home, workplaces, or other non-traditional locations, including on-site evaluation, diagnostics, triage, treatment, preventive care, chronic disease management, and care gap closure. Services are provided by a network of clinicians using a proprietary platform, combining in-person and virtual care.

products.name: Virtual Care Management
products.description: Remote healthcare management services, including telehealth and remote patient monitoring, provided through a 50-state virtual care network. Services include white-label telehealth for consumer, healthcare, and digital wellness brands, and chronic condition monitoring for patients, leveraging digital connectivity and virtual clinicians.

products.name: Medical Transportation Services
products.description: Digitally-enabled non-emergency and emergency medical transportation, including ambulance services, provided under the Ambulnz brand. Services include patient transfers between clinical settings and access to clinical services, using a fleet of vehicles equipped with proprietary technology integrated with EMR systems for efficient order management and tracking.

products.name: Government Contract Services (including Migrant-Related Programs)
products.description: Healthcare and non-medical services (such as shelter and security) provided under government contracts, including specialized programs for migrant populations. These services are delivered at scale, often as part of public health initiatives or emergency response, and may include both medical and ancillary support.

products.name: Aviation Fuel Supply and Services
products.description: Provision of aviation fuel and comprehensive service solutions, including fuel management, ground handling, dispatch, and trip support, to commercial airlines, cargo carriers, airports, and government entities. Delivered via a global network of on-airport fueling operations and third-party suppliers.

products.name: Land Fuel and Natural Gas Supply
products.description: Sale and distribution of liquid fuels and natural gas to commercial, industrial, government, and retail customers, primarily in North America, using a reseller model and cardlock network. Includes both contract and spot sales.

products.name: Marine Fuel and Lubricant Supply and Services
products.description: Marketing and resale of marine fuel and lubricants, along with related services such as procurement management, price risk management, quality control, and claims management, to marine customers worldwide. Delivered through a global network and includes both spot and contract sales.

products.name: Sustainability and Renewable Energy Solutions
products.description: Provision of sustainability-related products and services, including renewable and lower-carbon fuels such as sustainable aviation fuel, and advisory offerings to help customers meet energy transition objectives. Delivered through supply chain development and collaboration with industry participants.

products.name: Gedatolisib Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Gedatolisib is an intravenously administered, pan-class I PI3K and mTOR inhibitor developed for the treatment of multiple solid tumor indications, primarily advanced breast cancer (HR+/HER2-) and metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC). It is produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing and delivered through clinical and, if approved, commercial distribution channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and clinical trial validation.

products.name: Personal Lines Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Distribution and placement of personal lines insurance products—including home, auto, umbrella, motorcycle, flood, and recreational insurance—through a network of corporate and franchise agents, leveraging proprietary technology and partnerships with over 200 carriers. Delivered via licensed agents and digital platforms, with policy fulfillment and servicing handled by centralized service centers.

products.name: Digital Insurance Quoting and Binding Platform (Digital Agent)
products.description: A proprietary online platform enabling clients to obtain insurance quotes and, in some cases, bind policies directly online or with agent assistance. The platform integrates with carrier systems and uses advanced data analytics to streamline the insurance shopping and purchasing process. Delivered digitally to consumers and agents nationwide.

products.name: Insurance Policy Servicing and Support
products.description: Ongoing support services for insurance clients, including handling inquiries, facilitating claims, processing policy changes and renewals, and cross-selling additional coverages. Delivered by fully licensed service agents through phone, text, mobile app, online chat, or email, supported by centralized service centers.

products.name: Franchise Insurance Agency Model
products.description: Offering franchise opportunities for entrepreneurs to operate local insurance agencies under the Goosehead brand, providing access to carrier relationships, technology, training, and back-office support. Franchisees pay initial and ongoing royalty fees and deliver personal lines insurance brokerage services in their communities.

products.name: Enterprise Insurance Distribution Partnerships
products.description: Insurance distribution solutions provided through partnerships with mortgage servicers, lenders, real estate companies, and other platforms, offering scalable insurance solutions to their customers via enterprise sales teams or embedded franchise models. Delivered through dedicated teams and technology integrations.

products.name: Filtration Media and Components
products.description: Manufactured using engineered polymers, resins, and fibers, these products include specialty filtration media and components for air and liquid purification in applications such as transportation, water filtration, industrial processes, life sciences, and HVAC. Production involves advanced material science, extrusion, and coating processes.

products.name: Extruded Mesh and Netting Products
products.description: Produced through extrusion of polymers and fibers, these mesh and netting products are used in agriculture, packaging, and various industrial applications. Manufacturing requires specialized extrusion and forming equipment.

products.name: Advanced Films
products.description: Thermoplastic polyurethane and other advanced films are manufactured with attributes such as UV and scratch resistance, clarity, and durability. Used in automotive paint protection, security glass, medical films, and smart glass, these films are produced via extrusion, coating, and lamination processes.

products.name: Tapes, Labels, and Release Liners
products.description: Manufactured using precision coating, adhesive application, and converting processes, these products include substrates for tapes, performance labels, and release liners for use in construction, industrial, medical, personal care, and graphic arts applications. Production is highly customized and regulated for specific end uses.

products.name: Specialty Paper and Packaging
products.description: Produced from wood pulp and specialty fibers, these premium papers and packaging materials are used for print collateral, advertising, direct mail, sustainable packaging, graphics, wallpaper, and consumer office products. Manufacturing involves papermaking, coating, and converting processes, with a focus on sustainability and customization.

products.name: Healthcare Materials and Solutions
products.description: This line includes advanced wound care materials, skin-friendly adhesives, device fixation products, and medical packaging, produced using specialized films, adhesives, and papers. Manufacturing is highly regulated and tailored for medical and wellness applications, requiring compliance with healthcare standards.

products.name: Research Models
products.description: Production and sale of purpose-bred small and large research animals (primarily rodents and non-human primates) for use in drug discovery and development, manufactured in controlled environments at global facilities and delivered to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, academic, and government clients.

products.name: Research Model Services
products.description: Outsourced services supporting the use and management of research models, including insourcing solutions (vivarium management and staffing), creation and maintenance of genetically engineered models, and research animal diagnostic services, delivered both at client sites and Charles River facilities.

products.name: Cell Solutions
products.description: Provision of consenting human donor-derived cellular materials, such as primary cells and blood components, for use in biomedical research, drug discovery, and cell therapy development, including clinical trials; materials are collected, processed, and supplied to research and therapy developers.

products.name: Discovery Services
products.description: Integrated drug discovery services supporting identification, validation, and optimization of drug candidates across modalities (small molecules, biologics, oligonucleotides, cell and gene therapies), including in vitro and in vivo studies, delivered through scientific expertise and advanced technologies at global facilities.

products.name: Safety Assessment Services
products.description: Comprehensive non-clinical safety and toxicology testing services (GLP and non-GLP), including in vitro and in vivo studies, pathology, safety pharmacology, and bioanalysis, required for regulatory submissions and product approvals, performed at specialized global laboratories.

products.name: Microbial Solutions (Quality Control Testing)
products.description: Products and services for microbial detection, identification, and endotoxin testing (including Endosafe®, Celsis®, and Accugenix® brands), providing in vitro quality control testing kits, reagents, instruments, software, and laboratory services for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and consumer products manufacturing.

products.name: Biologics Testing Services
products.description: Analytical and safety testing services for biologic drugs, including cGMP and GLP testing, lot release, viral clearance, and characterization, performed at specialized laboratories to support regulatory submissions and commercial manufacturing for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients.

products.name: Contract Development and Manufacturing (CDMO) Services for Cell and Gene Therapies
products.description: Comprehensive contract development and manufacturing services for cell and gene therapies, including cell therapy, viral vector, and plasmid DNA production, with cGMP facilities supporting process development, manufacturing, and storage for clinical and commercial applications.

products.name: EVO756 (MRGPRX2 Antagonist Therapies)
products.description: A portfolio of oral small molecule therapies targeting the MRGPRX2 receptor, initially developed for chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU), atopic dermatitis (AD), and with expansion potential into other chronic inflammatory diseases such as migraine, asthma, interstitial cystitis, irritable bowel syndrome, and pruritus. These are manufactured through chemical synthesis and delivered as oral medications, requiring clinical development and regulatory approval.

products.name: EVO301 (SAFA-IL-18BP Fusion Protein Therapies)
products.description: A long-acting injectable fusion protein therapy consisting of an IL-18 binding protein and an anti-serum albumin Fab-associated domain, designed to neutralize the IL-18 inflammatory pathway. Initially developed for moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis and ulcerative colitis, with potential expansion into Crohn’s disease and cardiovascular-related inflammatory conditions. Manufactured using biologic processes and delivered via intravenous or subcutaneous injection.

products.name: Preclinical Immunology and Inflammation Drug Candidates
products.description: A pipeline of discovery-stage and preclinical small molecule and biologic drug candidates targeting key drivers of chronic inflammatory diseases, leveraging advanced scientific tools and drug discovery expertise. These candidates are in early research and development and not yet in clinical trials or commercialized.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Brokerage Services
products.description: Facilitates the buying and selling of existing homes through a network of company-owned and franchised brokerage offices, utilizing independent sales agents and digital platforms. Services are delivered via in-person agent support, marketing, and transaction management, supported by proprietary technology and brand recognition.

products.name: Real Estate Franchise Services
products.description: Provides franchise rights to operate under well-known real estate brands, offering franchisees branding, technology, marketing, training, and support services. Revenue is generated from royalties and marketing fees based on franchisee sales, with services delivered through long-term franchise agreements and ongoing support.

products.name: Title, Escrow, and Settlement Services
products.description: Offers full-service title, escrow, and settlement services to consumers, real estate companies, corporations, and financial institutions, primarily supporting residential real estate transactions. Services include title search, examination, policy issuance, closing, and funds disbursement, delivered through licensed offices and a network of agents and attorneys.

products.name: Corporate Relocation Services
products.description: Delivers comprehensive employee relocation services for corporate clients, managing all aspects of employee moves including homesale assistance, policy counseling, group move management, expense processing, and visa/immigration support. Services are outsourced by corporations and delivered through specialized teams and technology platforms.

products.name: Lead Generation Services
products.description: Generates and distributes high-quality real estate leads to independent sales agents and brokerages through benefit programs, partnerships, and digital initiatives. Services are delivered via proprietary platforms and strategic alliances with organizations and lenders.

products.name: Mortgage Origination Services (via Joint Venture)
products.description: Through a minority-owned joint venture, offers mortgage loan origination services for home purchases and refinancing, marketed to real estate agents, relocation clients, and consumers. Services are delivered through licensed mortgage professionals and digital channels, with loans sold in the secondary market.

products.name: Title Insurance Underwriting (via Joint Venture)
products.description: Participates as a minority owner in a joint venture that underwrites title insurance policies for real estate transactions. The underwriting business is regulated and delivers policies through a network of agents and agencies.

products.name: Personal Care Materials and Components
products.description: Manufactured specialty materials and components used in personal care products such as baby diapers, adult incontinence products, and feminine care. Production involves large-scale manufacturing using polymer resin, wood-based fibers, and pulps.

products.name: Wipes and Cleaning Materials
products.description: Production of specialty materials for disposable wipes and cleaning products, delivered through manufacturing facilities using organic and synthetic raw ingredients.

products.name: Filtration Materials
products.description: Manufactures filtration media and materials for air and liquid filtration applications, produced in dedicated manufacturing facilities using specialty fibers and polymers.

products.name: Food and Beverage Filter Materials
products.description: Produces specialty filter materials for food and beverage applications, including tea bags and coffee filters, using advanced manufacturing processes with organic and synthetic fibers.

products.name: Medical Garment Materials
products.description: Manufactures specialty materials used in medical garments, produced in large-scale facilities with regulated processes for healthcare applications.

products.name: Cable Wrap Materials
products.description: Produces specialty materials used as cable wrap in infrastructure and industrial applications, manufactured using synthetic and organic fibers.

products.name: Dryer Sheet Materials
products.description: Manufactures materials used in dryer sheets for consumer laundry applications, produced in manufacturing facilities using specialty fibers.

products.name: Automotive Rearview Mirrors and Electronics
products.description: Designs, develops, manufactures, and markets interior and exterior automatic-dimming and non-dimming rearview mirrors, as well as integrated automotive electronics (including HomeLink, driver/cabin monitoring, lighting, camera, and display systems) for OEM and aftermarket automotive customers. Products are physically manufactured and shipped globally.

products.name: Premium Audio Products
products.description: Designs, manufactures, distributes, and markets high-quality audio equipment including loudspeakers, A/V receivers, headphones, home theater systems, and related electronics for consumer, commercial, and cinema markets. Products are physically manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Dimmable Aircraft Windows
products.description: Manufactures and sells variable dimmable windows for commercial aircraft, using proprietary electrochromic technology to control light transmission. Products are physically manufactured and supplied to aircraft OEMs and operators worldwide.

products.name: Fire Protection Technologies and Smart Home Safety Systems
products.description: Manufactures and markets smoke detectors, carbon monoxide alarms, signaling devices, and integrated smart home safety systems (PLACE®) with room-specific sensors and connectivity, for residential and commercial use. Products are physically manufactured and sold through distributors and retailers.

products.name: Aftermarket Automotive Electronics and Accessories
products.description: Sells and distributes select automotive electronic technologies, equipment, accessories, and entertainment products (including security, remote start, infotainment, camera, and sensing systems) for vehicle enhancement and customization in the aftermarket. Products are sourced and distributed to dealerships, retailers, and online channels.

products.name: Consumer Electronic Products and Accessories
products.description: Sells and distributes consumer electronic products and accessories (such as wireless/Bluetooth speakers, headphones, HDTV antennas, solar power systems, and home electronic accessories) primarily in European markets. Products are sourced and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Biometric Authentication and Access Control Solutions
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and markets biometric authentication and access control products (including iris-based and multi-modal systems) for identity verification in automotive, commercial, institutional, and regulated industries. Solutions are delivered as hardware and software platforms, often integrated into other products or environments.

products.name: Low-Vision Smart Glasses (eSight)
products.description: Develops and sells advanced low-vision smart glasses (eSightGo®) for individuals with visual impairments, using proprietary technology compatible with multiple eye conditions. Products are manufactured and sold directly to consumers and through distributors.

products.name: Wireless Power Transfer Systems
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and commercializes wireless power transfer systems for a variety of industries, leveraging proprietary technology through a partnership with Solace Power. Products are intended for integration into other devices or systems.

products.name: Therapeutic Botulinum Toxin (ABP-450)
products.description: A biologic injectable botulinum toxin type A complex, manufactured via fermentation and purification, developed as a biosimilar to Botox® for physician-administered therapeutic indications such as chronic migraine, cervical dystonia, spasticity, overactive bladder, and other FDA-approved therapeutic uses. Delivered through in-person healthcare provider administration, subject to regulatory approval and requiring cGMP-compliant manufacturing.

products.name: Luxury Accessories
products.description: Handbags, small leather goods, and other accessories designed and manufactured under the Versace, Jimmy Choo, and Michael Kors brands, sold through retail, e-commerce, and wholesale channels. Production involves global sourcing, third-party manufacturing, and in-house design expertise.

products.name: Luxury Footwear
products.description: Women's and men's luxury shoes designed and produced under the Versace, Jimmy Choo, and Michael Kors brands, distributed globally via retail stores, e-commerce, and wholesale. Manufacturing is primarily in Italy and Asia, using both owned ateliers and third-party contractors.

products.name: Luxury Apparel (Ready-to-Wear and Haute Couture)
products.description: Ready-to-wear and haute couture clothing for men and women under the Versace and Michael Kors brands, including Michael Kors Collection, MICHAEL Michael Kors, and Versace Jeans Couture. Products are designed in-house and manufactured by third-party contractors, with a focus on craftsmanship and luxury materials.

products.name: Licensed Luxury Products (Eyewear, Watches, Jewelry, Fragrance, Home Furnishings, Tableware)
products.description: Eyewear, watches, jewelry, fragrance, home furnishings, and tableware produced under licensing agreements for Versace, Jimmy Choo, and Michael Kors brands. These products are designed in collaboration with licensees and distributed globally through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Passenger Air Transportation Services
products.description: United provides scheduled air transportation for passengers across a comprehensive global network, utilizing a hub-and-spoke system and a fleet of mainline and regional aircraft. Service is delivered through physical aircraft operations, requiring significant regulated infrastructure, in-person labor, and capital investment.

products.name: Air Cargo Services
products.description: United offers freight and mail transportation services to commercial businesses, freight forwarders, logistics firms, and postal services, using cargo capacity on scheduled passenger flights, interline and charter flights, and ground trucking. This service relies on physical aircraft and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Loyalty Program (MileagePlus)
products.description: United operates the MileagePlus loyalty program, allowing members to earn and redeem miles for flights, upgrades, and non-travel awards. The program is delivered digitally and through partnerships with airlines, credit card issuers, and other merchants.

products.name: Third-Party Maintenance Services
products.description: United provides maintenance services to third parties, leveraging its technical operations and facilities to service external customers' aircraft. This service requires specialized labor, regulated infrastructure, and technical expertise.

products.name: Flight Training Services
products.description: United offers flight academy services to external customers, providing pilot and aviation training using specialized facilities, simulators, and certified instructors. This is a regulated, in-person service.

products.name: Ground Handling Services
products.description: United provides ground handling services to third parties, including ramp, baggage, and aircraft servicing at airports. This service is delivered through in-person labor and airport infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans to businesses, government entities, and agricultural clients, including real estate, commercial, and agricultural loans. Lending is delivered through in-person bankers at branches and is governed by comprehensive credit policies and underwriting standards.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers loans to individual consumers, including personal loans and mortgages, delivered through branch offices and digital channels, with underwriting and servicing managed by the bank.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Provides traditional deposit accounts such as checking, savings, and time deposits to individuals, businesses, and government entities, delivered through physical branches and digital banking platforms. Includes FDIC-insured deposits and specialized products like repurchase agreements and IntraFi Network services.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Delivers trust, investment management, employee benefit, insurance, agency, and custodial services to individuals, businesses, and nonprofit organizations. Services are provided by specialized staff and include estate administration, investment account management, and insurance planning.

products.name: Mortgage Loan Origination and Servicing
products.description: Originates and services residential mortgage loans for individuals, including both the initial lending and ongoing loan servicing, delivered through branch offices and digital channels.

products.name: Online and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Provides digital banking access for individuals and businesses, enabling account management, funds transfer, and other banking services via online and mobile platforms.

products.name: Automotive Seating Systems
products.description: Designs, engineers, manufactures, and delivers complete seating systems for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and light trucks. Production involves global manufacturing, assembly, and sequencing facilities, with standardized processes and vertical integration.

products.name: Automotive Seating Components
products.description: Produces and supplies individual seating components such as frames, mechanisms, foam, head restraints, armrests, and trim covers. These components are manufactured using proprietary technologies and are delivered to OEMs or used in Adient's own seat assemblies.

products.name: Sustainable and Advanced Seating Solutions
products.description: Develops and manufactures innovative seating products emphasizing sustainability, lighter weight, and advanced materials, including seats with recycled content, low-emission foam, and ergonomic designs. Delivered as part of complete systems or components to OEMs.

products.name: Lung Diagnostic Testing Services
products.description: Blood-based diagnostic testing services for lung disease, including risk assessment of lung nodules, treatment guidance, and monitoring for lung cancer. Tests are performed in CLIA-certified labs and delivered to healthcare providers, requiring specialized laboratory infrastructure and scientific expertise.

products.name: Biopharmaceutical and Life Sciences Development Services
products.description: Comprehensive diagnostic development and consulting services for biopharmaceutical, life sciences, and diagnostic companies, including research, discovery, assay design, clinical trial testing, regulatory, reimbursement, commercialization, and logistics support. Delivered through scientific and operational expertise and laboratory capabilities.

products.name: Blood-Based Lung Nodule Risk Assessment Tests (Nodify Lung)
products.description: Blood-based proteomic tests (Nodify CDT and Nodify XL2) that assess the risk of malignancy in pulmonary nodules, integrating biomarker results with imaging and clinical data. Tests are processed in specialized labs and results are provided to physicians to guide nodule management decisions.

products.name: Blood-Based Lung Cancer Treatment Guidance and Monitoring Tests (IQLung)
products.description: Blood-based tests (VeriStrat, GeneStrat ddPCR, GeneStrat NGS) for immune profiling and tumor genomic profiling in lung cancer patients, supporting treatment selection and monitoring. Tests use proteomic and genomic technologies and are processed in CLIA-certified labs.

products.name: Custom Diagnostic Test Development and Clinical Trial Testing Services
products.description: Custom design, development, validation, and testing of novel diagnostic assays for external clients, including support for therapeutic clinical trials and validation of life sciences tools. Delivered through laboratory and scientific resources under contract.

products.name: Pan-Cancer Blood-Based Diagnostic Tests (Pipeline)
products.description: Emerging blood-based diagnostic tests for cancers beyond lung, including risk of recurrence (ROR), molecular residual disease (MRD), and immune profiling (e.g., VeriStrat for colorectal, endometrial, and prostate cancer; ESR1 monitoring for breast cancer). Developed in partnership and offered as laboratory services.

products.name: Barostim Neuromodulation System
products.description: An implantable, minimally invasive medical device system that delivers electrical pulses to baroreceptors in the carotid artery to modulate the autonomic nervous system, primarily for the treatment of heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). The system includes an implantable pulse generator (IPG), stimulation lead, wireless clinician programmer, and single-use surgical accessories. Devices are manufactured at the company's facility and sold to hospitals and clinics, with implantation performed by surgeons in an outpatient procedure.

products.name: Barostim Therapy for Resistant Hypertension
products.description: A neuromodulation therapy delivered via the Barostim system, indicated for the treatment of drug-resistant hypertension. The therapy involves the same implantable device platform as for heart failure, with regulatory approvals in Europe and a Humanitarian Device Exemption (HDE) in the U.S. for select patients. Delivered through the same manufacturing and sales channels as the heart failure indication.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Comprehensive retail banking services including checking, savings, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, internet banking, and ATM access, delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital platforms in Puerto Rico, Florida, and the Virgin Islands.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Banking
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of residential mortgage loans, including FHA, VA, RD, conforming, and non-conforming loans, with activities such as secondary market sales and mortgage-backed securities issuance, requiring regulatory compliance and specialized underwriting.

products.name: Commercial and Corporate Banking Services
products.description: Lending and deposit services for large and middle-market businesses and government entities, including commercial real estate, C&I loans, lines of credit, and term loans, typically secured by real estate or personal guarantees, delivered through relationship managers and specialized teams.

products.name: Small Loan Financing
products.description: Origination of small personal loans through a specialized finance company subsidiary, delivered via a network of dedicated offices, requiring in-person customer service and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Automobile Financing
products.description: Provision of loans for automobile purchases, likely involving underwriting, collateral management, and in-person or digital application processes, delivered through bank branches and specialized subsidiaries.

products.name: Insurance Agency Services
products.description: Distribution and sale of insurance products as a registered insurance agency, requiring licensed agents and compliance with insurance regulations, delivered through dedicated subsidiaries and bank branches.

products.name: Investment and Treasury Services
products.description: Management of investment portfolios and treasury functions, including funding, liquidity management, and investment securities transactions, delivered through centralized financial operations and requiring financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Traditional Banking Services
products.description: Includes deposit accounts, cash management, payment processing, and lending (consumer, commercial, and mortgage loans), delivered through physical branches and digital channels. Requires regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive investment management, trust, private banking, and financial planning services for individuals, businesses, non-profits, and municipalities, delivered by experienced professionals. Requires financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Investment and Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Offers brokerage, annuity products, and certain types of insurance through a third-party partnership, expanding the range of financial products available to customers. Delivered via referral and partnership model.

products.name: Targeted Oncology Therapeutics (Small Molecule Inhibitors)
products.description: Small molecule drugs designed to selectively target and kill cancer cells with specific genetic alterations, such as MTAP-deleted cancers, using precision oncology and synthetic lethality strategies. These therapeutics are developed through in-house discovery platforms and delivered as oral medications, requiring extensive clinical development and regulatory approval.

products.name: PRMT5 Inhibitors (Vopimetostat and TNG456)
products.description: A class of small molecule drugs that selectively inhibit PRMT5 in MTAP-deleted cancer cells, developed for use as monotherapy or in combination with other agents. These are manufactured externally and delivered orally, with clinical trials focused on solid tumors such as pancreatic, lung, and CNS cancers.

products.name: CoREST Inhibitor (TNG260)
products.description: A first-in-class small molecule inhibitor targeting the CoREST complex, developed for treatment of STK11 mutant/KRAS wild-type NSCLC. Delivered as an oral drug, it is evaluated both as monotherapy and in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors in clinical trials.

products.name: HBS1L Degrader (TNG961)
products.description: A novel small molecule 'molecular glue' that induces degradation of HBS1L protein in FOCAD-deleted/MTAP-deleted solid tumors. Currently in preclinical/IND-enabling development, it is intended for use in genetically defined cancer populations.

products.name: Antibody-Drug Conjugate (ADC) Therapies
products.description: A portfolio of next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) targeting PTK7, MUC16, and SEZ6 tumor antigens, utilizing the CPT113 linker-payload platform to deliver a proprietary TOP1 inhibitor payload to cancer cells. These biologic therapeutics are developed through advanced antibody engineering, conjugation chemistry, and are manufactured via outsourced partners for clinical and, if approved, commercial use.

products.name: Offshore Drilling Services
products.description: Provision of offshore drilling services to oil and gas companies using owned and operated drillships, semi-submersible rigs, and jackup rigs, delivered through physical deployment of rigs and skilled crews in global locations on a contract dayrate basis.

products.name: Drilling Unit Management Services
products.description: Management of drilling units owned by affiliated entities, involving operational oversight and technical management, delivered through specialized personnel and processes for third-party rig owners.

products.name: ShotSpotter Gunshot Detection Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based gunshot detection and alerting system using proprietary acoustic sensors and software, deployed in outdoor environments to detect, locate, and notify authorities of gunfire incidents. Delivered as a subscription service, with real-time alerts and forensic reporting, and includes specialized versions for campuses and corporate sites.

products.name: CrimeTracer Investigative Data Platform
products.description: A cloud-based crime data and intelligence platform providing law enforcement with access to over one billion records, AI-driven analysis, natural language search, and automated briefings to generate leads and accelerate investigations. Delivered as a SaaS subscription, integrates with other public safety tools.

products.name: CaseBuilder Case Management System
products.description: A digital case management solution for law enforcement, enabling structured tracking, reporting, collaboration, and analysis of investigations. Provides analytical tools, supervisor dashboards, and integrates with other public safety systems. Delivered as a SaaS subscription or on-premises solution.

products.name: ResourceRouter Patrol Management Solution
products.description: AI-driven patrol and resource deployment software for law enforcement, optimizing patrol routes and resource allocation based on real-time data and predictive analytics. Delivered as a SaaS subscription, enhances operational efficiency and community engagement.

products.name: PlateRanger Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR)
products.description: AI-powered ALPR and vehicle identification solution for law enforcement and security teams, providing real-time vehicle and plate data, investigative leads, and integrations with other public safety platforms. Delivered as a SaaS subscription, supports both public and private sector clients.

products.name: SafePointe AI-Based Weapons Detection System
products.description: Passive, AI-based concealed weapons detection system using hardware and software to screen individuals at facility entrances without traditional checkpoints. Designed for high-throughput environments such as hospitals, casinos, and corporate campuses. Delivered as a subscription based on number of entry lanes.

products.name: Specialized Gunshot Detection for Critical Infrastructure
products.description: Perimeter-based sniper gunshot detection solution targeting utility substations and critical infrastructure, leveraging core gunshot detection technology for specialized use cases. Piloted through SoundThinking Labs and delivered to utility and infrastructure customers.

products.name: Forensic Reporting and Expert Witness Services
products.description: Provision of detailed forensic reports and certified expert witness testimony related to gunshot incidents detected by ShotSpotter, supporting investigations and court proceedings. Delivered as a professional service to law enforcement and legal entities.

products.name: Integration and Advisory Services
products.description: Integration of public safety solutions with third-party technologies (e.g., drones, video surveillance, ALPR) and provision of strategic advisory services to law enforcement and security teams. Delivered as professional services to enhance solution value and operational outcomes.
